instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a constrained thermal stress analysis (Case A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Part:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 10 mm x 10 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane (Y from 0 to 10, Z from 0 to 10). Extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 100 mm.

Property:
Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and thermal expansion coefficient = 1.2e-5 /K.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the bar.

Step:
Create a Static, General step named Step-Thermal-A.

Load:
Apply a predefined temperature field of 20 degC to the whole model in the Initial step. Fix both end faces with U1 = U2 = U3 = 0: the left end face at X = 0 and the right end face at X = 100 mm. In Step-Thermal-A, apply a predefined temperature field of 120 degC to the whole model.

Mesh:
Apply a global seed size of 5 mm. Assign element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job:
Create a job named Job-ThermalStress-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion.

Save:
Save the model database to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-ThermalStress-A.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-ThermalStress-A.odb.
